title: Understanding the Loss Function
text: The loss function here is the difference between the actual value \(y_i\) and the predicted value \(f_{\theta}(x_i)\). Think about how this difference affects the gradient descent update.

title: Partial Derivative with Respect to \(\theta_0\)
text: To find \(A\), consider the partial derivative of the loss function \(L(\theta)\) with respect to \(\theta_0\). Remember, \(f_{\theta}(x)=\theta_0*0.5+\theta_0*\theta_1*x_1+\sin(\theta_1)*x_2\).
